seed_genes.justification: Disease gene; p.Leu737Ter null + p.Asn1002Lys hypomorph reduces BubR1 and weakens the spindle assembly checkpoint.
SAC kinase partnering BubR1 at kinetochores; its loss phenocopies checkpoint weakness.
GLEBS-domain partner of BubR1/Bub1 in the mitotic checkpoint complex.
Mad2 core of the checkpoint complex restraining CDC20-APC/C.
Mad1; biallelic MAD1L1 variants cause an MVA-like phenotype; recruits Mad2.
APC/C activator directly restrained by the checkpoint complex - the SAC effector.
Kinetochore scaffold docking Bub3-BubR1 and PP2A-B56 for error correction.
PP2A-B56 regulatory subunit recruited through the BubR1 KARD domain; error correction.
B56-delta subunit of the same kinetochore PP2A module.
MVA2 disease gene; centrosome/spindle integrity with the same clinical phenotype.
MVA3 disease gene; AAA+ ATPase governing checkpoint-complex disassembly.
Deacetylates and stabilizes BubR1; a druggable NAD+-dependent lever on residual BubR1.
Chromosomal-passenger kinase opposing PP2A-B56 in attachment error correction.
p16 senescence effector; clearing p16+ cells rescued the BubR1-hypomorph mouse.
p21; the p53-driven proliferative brake executed downstream of aneuploidy.
Guardian node of the aneuploidy response; drives the senescence axis and cancer context.
mTOR sustains the senescent state; approved rapalogs are the lead senomorphics.
AMPK alpha1; energy-sensing node engaged by metformin-class agents.
AMPK alpha2 catalytic subunit; same energy-sensing axis.
MPS1; aneuploid cells are dependent on residual checkpoint tone - interception lever.
Kinesin-8; chromosomally unstable cells are selectively dependent on KIF18A.
